set.body:
WHY: grakern is a kernel calculus over a pluggable topology, but GraphSample is bound to graph4s.Graph (simple, undirected, loopless) and WLTrace reads incidences from it directly. Consumers with directed labelled multigraphs (storymodel4s proposition charts) cannot be represented, and graph4s becomes a transitive ontology dependency of every consumer. This refactor makes grakern's own claim true and is the prerequisite for direction, edge policy, and the portable emitter.

SCOPE (in core): a minimal protocol exposing only what WL/OA refinement consumes —
  trait LabelledNeighbourhood[V, NK, EK]: vertices: IndexedSeq[V]; nodeKey(v): NK; incidences(v): IndexedSeq[Incidence[V, EK]] where Incidence(other: V, edgeKey: EK, orientation: Orientation) and enum Orientation { Outgoing, Incoming, Undirected }.
  GraphSample becomes an adapter-produced value (graph4s adapter in grakern-graph4s; nothing in core/standard imports graph4s). Existing build/fromFields become graph4s-adapter functions with the same names.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. grakern-core and grakern-standard compile with no graph4s dependency; grakern-graph4s is the only module importing graph4s.
2. All existing GraKeL and GraphKernels.jl parity fixtures pass unchanged through the graph4s adapter (bit-identical features, gram, cross).
3. A second adapter (test-scope) over a plain adjacency-list digraph with labelled parallel edges builds a LabelledNeighbourhood and runs WL subtree + OA end to end.
4. Protocol minimality: the trait exposes exactly vertices, nodeKey, incidences; any richer need is met by the adapter, not by widening the trait (documented in ADR-002).
5. Fingerprintability unchanged: named codecs/projections still yield durable SemanticFingerprint; ephemeral otherwise.

PROPOSED TESTS
- ParityUnchangedSuite: for every committed fixture, features/gram/cross via new adapter == golden (exact equality on doubles).
- AdapterLawSuite (Discipline): incidences(v) contains other iff incidences(other) contains v for Undirected; Outgoing at v iff Incoming at other for directed adapters; vertices distinct; keys total.
- MinimalitySuite: compile-time check (scala reflection or a source test) that core exposes no graph4s symbol; `sbt coreJS/compile coreNative/compile standardJS/compile standardNative/compile` in CI.
- DigraphAdapterSuite: parallel edges (two keyed incidences between the same pair) refine to different colours than a single edge.
set.title: Topology-neutral labelled-neighbourhood protocol in core; graph4s becomes one adapter (prerequisite for direction, edge policy, portable emitter)
